name: HTS_SCHED_PROCESSES
description: Schedules processes submitted as asynchronous batch requests

columns.name: SCHED_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Primary key identifiying the process record

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Type of process to be executed (for instance Publish, or Reset to Last Published)

columns.name: SCHEDULER_ID
columns.description: User ID of the scheduler submitting the job

columns.name: SCHED_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Scheduler Pofile ID of the user submitting the job; null value corresponds to the default scheduler pofile (scheduling a manager's directs)

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date for the range of the schedule data being processed

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date for the range of the schedule data being processed

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the request submission time  of the batch job submitted to execute the process

columns.name: EXEC_START_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the start time of execution of the main batch job that executes the process

columns.name: EXEC_END_TIME
columns.description: Indicates the end time of execution of the main batch job that executed the process

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
